title: Penn Taiwanese Society
content_html:
Penn Taiwanese Society (PTS) is the undergraduate Taiwanese student organization at the University of Pennsylvania, founded in 1990 according to the organization’s own Instagram bio. Listed on both Penn’s Pan-Asian American Community House (PAACH) directory and the official Penn Clubs platform, PTS describes itself as “the destination for all undergraduate students interested in Taiwanese affairs.” The organization is open to students of all backgrounds and emphasizes cultural community-building on campus.

PTS hosts a range of cultural and social programming throughout the year. Signature events include Night Market — described as “a collaboration replicating the experience of an authentic Taiwanese night market” — as well as an annual Bubble Tea Social, educational workshops, dim sum outings, and karaoke trips. The organization also runs a recurring Next Stop Taiwan program for members. PTS has engaged with the broader Taiwanese advocacy community, including hosting a visit from Outreach for Taiwan in 2016 to discuss student movements in Taiwan.
